messages:
sara: Hey support — our org (org_acme_123) shows 0 tokens in Usage -> hourly for 2026-03-24 10:00-13:00 UTC. Other orgs look fine. We saw a burst of 503s earlier. Can someone check?
eli: Thanks — can you paste the org id and exact window? any correlating alerts or trace ids?
sara: org_id: org_acme_123; window: 2026-03-24T10:00-13:00Z. No infra alerts on our side. trace id from client logs: trc-8f3ad.
ops-bot: rollup-worker-0: job 2026-03-24T10:05 FAILED (OOM) -> restarting, retry count=0
eli: Looks like a rollup partition didn't complete. I'm going to check partitions and potentially run a manual backfill. maya, can you join?
maya: Running quick check:
```sql
SELECT hour_partition, count(*) FROM usage_hourly
WHERE org_id='org_acme_123' AND hour >= '2026-03-24 10:00'
GROUP BY hour_partition;
```
Result: partition 2026-03-24T10:00 missing, 11:00 present, 12:00 partial (only 20% rows).
eli: Thanks — initiating manual rollup backfill for 10:00-14:00 to be safe.
```bash
backfill-cli --org org_acme_123 --start 2026-03-24T10:00 --end 2026-03-24T14:00 --type=rollup --priority=high
```
ops-bot: backfill-job-874 started by eli; ETA ~ 40m; streaming progress here.
maya: Root cause prelim: rollup-worker crashed when fetching model-service metrics (503 burst). Partition lock logic did not retry on transient fetch errors so the partition remained in limbo. I have a small patch to add exponential retry + circuit breaker.
sara: Will this affect billing/invoice calculations?
eli: Billing pipeline uses raw ingest and a separate aggregation path. This backfill will fix the console charts. Billing totals should be unchanged, but I'll run a quick compare once backfill finishes and open a ticket if we detect drift.
maya: backfill progress: processed partitions 10:00 and 11:00, 12:00 in progress (current rate ~ 2.7k rows/min). ETA ~ 22m.
ops-bot: backfill-job-874: partition 2026-03-24T10:00 inserted 624 rows; partition 2026-03-24T11:00 inserted 1,200 rows.
ops-bot: backfill-job-874 completed successfully; total rows inserted: 3,120; partitions fixed: 4
eli: Console should reflect corrected hourly metrics in ~3-5 minutes after cache invalidation. Follow-up: PR #432 (retry + lock fix) landed and will be deployed to prod in next deploy window; assigned to @maya. Runbook for manual rollup: <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/rollup-backfill>.
sara: :thumbsup: thanks everyone, confirmed numbers back on dashboard for the window.
maya: marking incident as resolved; will monitor 24h for recurrence and post postmortem if we see similar failures.
